summary: 79-year-old male from Ballwin, Missouri with a significant medical emergency ~1 mile from the Lumpy Ridge Trailhead on the Gem Lake Trail; rangers reached him at noon, litter-carried him to the trailhead, then ambulance to a nearby meadow where St. Anthony Flight for Life flew him to Boulder Community Hospital.
location: Gem Lake Trail, ~1 mile from Lumpy Ridge Trailhead, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers | Estes Park Medical Center ambulance | St. Anthony Flight for Life
notes: Same Thursday (Jul 12, 2012) as the Andrews Glacier fatality per NPT article and NPS morning report (Mon Jul 16, 2012): 911 call for the 79-yo; rangers at noon; litter carry to trailhead; ambulance to meadow; FFL to Boulder Community Hospital. A separate 74-year-old man in distress near Fern Falls the same day declined ambulance transport after reaching the trailhead - not inserted. | NPS ROMO morning-report compendium URL merged (run 487).
